query:
-- Lavande - Provence
INSERT INTO plant_terroirs (plant_id, terroir_id, local_name, quality_notes)
SELECT p.id, t.id, 'Lavande de Provence', 'AOC Lavande fine de Haute-Provence, qualité supérieure'
FROM plants p, terroirs t
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Lavande%' AND t.name LIKE '%Provence%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_terroirs pt WHERE pt.plant_id = p.id AND pt.terroir_id = t.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Rose - Grasse
INSERT INTO plant_terroirs (plant_id, terroir_id, local_name, quality_notes)
SELECT p.id, t.id, 'Rose de Mai', 'Rose centifolia traditionnelle de Grasse'
FROM plants p, terroirs t
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Rose%' AND t.name LIKE '%Grasse%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_terroirs pt WHERE pt.plant_id = p.id AND pt.terroir_id = t.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Jasmin - Grasse
INSERT INTO plant_terroirs (plant_id, terroir_id, local_name, quality_notes)
SELECT p.id, t.id, 'Jasmin de Grasse', 'Jasmin grandiflorum de qualité exceptionnelle'
FROM plants p, terroirs t
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Jasmin%' AND t.name LIKE '%Grasse%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_terroirs pt WHERE pt.plant_id = p.id AND pt.terroir_id = t.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Vétiver - Haïti
INSERT INTO plant_terroirs (plant_id, terroir_id, local_name, quality_notes)
SELECT p.id, t.id, 'Vétiver d''Haïti', 'Qualité bourbon, notes terreuses et fumées'
FROM plants p, terroirs t
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Vétiver%' AND t.country LIKE '%Haïti%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_terroirs pt WHERE pt.plant_id = p.id AND pt.terroir_id = t.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Ylang-ylang - Madagascar
INSERT INTO plant_terroirs (plant_id, terroir_id, local_name, quality_notes)
SELECT p.id, t.id, 'Ylang-ylang de Madagascar', 'Qualité Extra, très florale'
FROM plants p, terroirs t
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Ylang%' AND t.country LIKE '%Madagascar%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_terroirs pt WHERE pt.plant_id = p.id AND pt.terroir_id = t.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Patchouli - Indonésie
INSERT INTO plant_terroirs (plant_id, terroir_id, local_name, quality_notes)
SELECT p.id, t.id, 'Patchouli de Sumatra', 'Qualité traditionnelle, notes terreuses profondes'
FROM plants p, terroirs t
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Patchouli%' AND t.country LIKE '%Indonésie%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_terroirs pt WHERE pt.plant_id = p.id AND pt.terroir_id = t.id)
LIMIT 1;
